question: Do matched groups differ in survival after accounting for the matching strata?
null: Within the specified strata, groups have the same survival function.
options: survival::survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ group + strata(match), data = d, rho = 0)
assumptions: Matching/strata are defined by design; meaningful group comparisons occur within strata.
Appropriate censoring and independence between matched sets.
parametric: Stratified Cox allows additional predictors and separate baseline hazards for strata.
nonparametric: Already a stratified nonparametric comparison; a permutation must honor matching and the event/censoring design.
title: Stratified log-rank test
code_simulate:
set.seed(240501)
stratum <- rep(1:12, each=10)
treatment <- rep(rep(c("Control", "Stress"), each=5), 12)
rate <- rep(seq(.025, .08, length.out=12), each=10)
event_time <- rexp(120, rate * ifelse(treatment=="Stress", 1.6, 1))
d <- data.frame(stratum, treatment, time=pmin(event_time, 30), event=event_time<=30)
write.csv(d, file.path(out_dir, "data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
code_plot:
fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, event) ~ treatment, data=d)
plot(fit, col=c("#146A85", "#C56B3B"), lwd=3, conf.int=FALSE,
     xlab="Days since exposure", ylab="Probability still alive", mark.time=TRUE)
legend("topright", c("Control", "Stress"), col=c("#146A85", "#C56B3B"), lwd=3, bty="n")
code_analysis:
result <- survival::survdiff(survival::Surv(time, event) ~ treatment + strata(stratum), data=d)
p_value <- pchisq(result$chisq, df=1, lower.tail=FALSE)
biology: Larval survival under stress is compared within 12 rearing blocks.
design: Independent larvae within known rearing blocks; administrative censoring at day 30.
generating_model: 120 independent exponential event times conditional on 12 fixed block rates evenly spaced from 0.025 to 0.08 per day. Stress multiplies every block rate by 1.6. Follow-up stops at 30 days.
generating_truth: Stress has a true hazard ratio of 1.6 within each block; the within-block equality null is false.
teaching_point: Stratification permits different baseline survival across known blocks.

plot_args.note: Matches treatment colors and line widths

practice: What biological variation does stratification account for here?
